La aplicación detecta el televisor en la red Wi-Fi, pero cuando intento conectarme nunca aparece el mensaje de autorización en la TV. Ya actualicé la aplicación, ambos dispositivos están en la misma red Wi-Fi, el permiso de Red Local está activado en mi iPhone y reinicié tanto el televisor como el teléfono. También borré la lista de dispositivos permitidos en la TV.

¿Podrían ayudarme a solucionar este problema? Si este modelo de televisor no es compatible, por favor indíquenmelo. Gracias.

reviews.title: Not Worth the Money
reviews.text:
I downloaded the iMote Remote app expecting a convenient way to control my TV and other devices, but it’s a complete disappointment. Why would anyone pay for this when free official remote apps from Fire TV, LG, Samsung, Roku, and others already do a much better job?
The app feels clunky, slow to connect, and often loses connection mid-use. The interface is outdated and not nearly as smooth or responsive as the built-in manufacturer apps. Basic functions like volume control and input switching are laggy, and half the “premium” features feel like things that should be standard in any remote app.
Save your money. Stick with the free remote apps that come with your Fire TV, LG, or other smart devices—they’re faster, more reliable, and don’t nickel-and-dime you for basic functionality. This app is not worth paying for at all.
